test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.

The doctor advised her to keep off the sweets for a while.

options.text: The doctor asked her, “Why don’t you keep off the sweets for a while?”
The doctor said to her, “You must keep off the sweets for a while.”
The doctor said to her, “Keep off the sweets for a while.”
The doctor said to her, “She must keep off the sweets for a while.”

solution:
The correct answer is - **The doctor said to her, “Keep off the sweets for a while.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

We need to make some required changes in the given sentence as per the rule.

__
 
• The sentence is in **the past tense**, so the word **'advised'** will be **changed into 'said to'**
 
• The preposition **'to'** will be replaced with **inverted commas (, ")**.
 
• Rest will remain the same and the most appropriate direct form would be:
 
 
• *The doctor said to her, “Keep off the sweets for a while.”*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• My coach suggested me to run as fast as possible.
 
 
• *My coach said to me, " run as fast as possible."*
 
 
 
• The teacher suggested him to buy a new pen for better writing.
 
 
• *The teacher said to him," buy a new pen for better writing."*
